verdict.rationale: Bulk or batch processing is a fair question for a transcription API, but the evidence documents only single-file operations: an async API taking one file or URL, and a CLI run as `gladia transcribe audio.mp3`. There is no batch endpoint or multi-item command. A pipe-friendly CLI for scripts and no-code integrations like Zapier, Make and n8n are building blocks or user-side workarounds, and volume-tiered pricing is not a bulk-operation capability, so none of these earns credit.
